title: PostgreSQL Enterprise Substrate — Source-of-Truth Taxonomy
principle: JSON/JSONL/CSV artifacts remain the portable, inspectable, diffable, replayable, schema-governed source-of-truth artifacts. Postgres is the enterprise operational substrate, never the sole authority for any content-bearing artifact. JSONB inside Postgres is a schema-governed representation of canonical envelopes, not an untyped dumping ground.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from artifacts; Postgres is operational read replica
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Session lifecycle audit trail, incident investigation, operational telemetry. No raw prompts/completions/file contents in this table.
data_classes.notes: Observability JSONL is the canonical authority. Postgres event_log is an operational projection for dashboard queries and incident forensics. Never store raw user content in Postgres.

data_classes.replay_rule: artifacts are source of truth; Postgres is downstream operational replica
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Operational monitoring, SLO dashboards, admin forensics, tenant usage reporting
data_classes.notes: Same physical source as session_events. Postgres stores envelope-level fields; raw payloads remain in artifact files only.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from envelope JSON files; Postgres stores envelope metadata + JSONB for querying by receipt_kind, session_id, actor
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Non-repudiation, tool invocation audit, compliance evidence
data_classes.notes: ReceiptStore protocol (rig_relay/evidence/receipt_store.py) currently filesystem-only. Postgres adapter implements same protocol for operational querying.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from trace_events.jsonl; Postgres stores trace_id, event_name, span metadata for correlation queries
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Distributed tracing correlation, latency root cause analysis, provider performance comparison
data_classes.notes: Trace events link tool invocations to LLM turns to provider calls. Postgres enables efficient span-search and GIN-indexed payload queries.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild state from events.jsonl; Postgres is operational store for active leases, conflicts, and projections
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Cross-session coordination, multi-agent lane management, path reservation audit, lease lifecycle forensics
data_classes.notes: File-based CoordinationStore (rig_relay/coordination/store.py) uses fcntl digester locks. Postgres advisory locks can replace this for cross-process coordination. Dual authority: events.jsonl remains canonical replay log; Postgres is operational hot path for lease acquisition and path conflict detection.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild workflow timeline from events; Postgres enables efficient task-to-path-to-session correlation queries
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Fleet orchestration visibility, mission progress tracking, subagent workstream audit, task lifecycle management
data_classes.notes: Subset of coordination events specific to task claims, heartbeats, releases. Postgres enables efficient JOIN across sessions, tasks, paths, and artifacts.

data_classes.replay_rule: artifacts are canonical; Postgres stores structured gate decisions for dashboard queries and compliance reporting
data_classes.procurement_relevance: RC readiness tracking, blocker burndown, compliance gate evidence, auditor-accessible gate history
data_classes.notes: Release gate JSON files are the canonical record. Postgres table provides fast lookup for cockpit blocker burndown widget and procurement compliance dashboards.

data_classes.replay_rule: JSONL is append-only source of truth; Postgres is operational query surface for status/severity/staleness aggregation
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Debt tracking, finding lifecycle management, triage workflow automation
data_classes.notes: JSONL is immutable by convention. Postgres stores finding_id, status, severity, kind, created_at for efficient queries. Postgres never mutates the JSONL.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from source observability JSONL files; Postgres materialized views for dashboard widgets
data_classes.procurement_relevance: SLO dashboards, usage trend analysis, tenant billing/usage reports, capacity planning
data_classes.notes: These are derived aggregates — counts, percentiles, rates with SHA256 hashed groupings only. No raw payloads. Postgres materialized views refresh from event_log for dashboard latency.

data_classes.replay_rule: JSON files are canonical; Postgres stores assembly metadata (symbol index, repo map hashes, compression plan) for context reuse across sessions
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Context assembly efficiency, cross-session symbol reuse, token budget optimization
data_classes.notes: Context artifacts contain symbol names and path hashes, not file contents. Postgres enables cross-session symbol index reuse and assembly plan caching.

data_classes.replay_rule: envelope JSON files are canonical; Postgres stores tool_name, session_id, status, latency_ms, sha256 hashes for query and analytics
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Tool invocation audit, permission enforcement evidence, latency SLO tracking
data_classes.notes: Envelope metadata only. Raw tool args, outputs, file content, and diffs never stored in Postgres. SHA256 hashes link back to envelope files.

data_classes.replay_rule: envelope JSON files are canonical; Postgres stores mutation metadata for preproduction audit
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Live mutation audit trail, adoption merge history, preproduction gate evidence
data_classes.notes: Mutation receipts capture which agent mutated which files in which worktree. Postgres enables query across mutations, worktrees, and adoption decisions.

data_classes.replay_rule: JSON files are canonical; Postgres stores packet metadata for provider health dashboards and status queries
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Provider integration health, capability status, auth state, rate limit tracking
data_classes.notes: Provider packets contain integration status and capability manifests. No raw API keys, tokens, or private user data in Postgres.

data_classes.replay_rule: JSON files are canonical; Postgres stores snapshot metadata for cockpit provider health widgets
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Multi-provider health monitoring, capability comparison, vendor evaluation dashboard
data_classes.notes: Operating picture snapshots show provider status, not secrets.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from source artifacts; Postgres stores computed projection blobs for WebSocket push and dashboard rendering
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Cockpit performance, projection cache invalidation, admin dashboard latency
data_classes.notes: Projection state is computed from canonical artifacts. Postgres enables efficient projection cache invalidation via LISTEN/NOTIFY. Projection blobs are signed SHA256 hashes, rebuilt on source artifact change.

data_classes.replay_rule: runtime-only ephemeral state; no export need
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Multi-user cockpit preferences (future), admin layout persistence
data_classes.notes: User layout preferences, widget visibility, disclosure levels. Local only. In enterprise hosted mode, scoped per tenant/session.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from preferences JSON; Postgres stores structured preferences for hosted multi-user scenarios
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Multi-user preference management, SSO integration, profile migration between instances
data_classes.notes: Preferences JSON is local-first. Postgres stores preferences for enterprise hosted mode with user identity scoping.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from consent JSON; Postgres stores consent state for enterprise audit
data_classes.procurement_relevance: GDPR/CCPA consent audit trail, enterprise opt-out enforcement evidence
data_classes.notes: Consent state must be auditable per tenant. Postgres stores consent history with timestamps for compliance.

data_classes.replay_rule: can export back to JSON; Postgres is canonical for enterprise identity operations
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Enterprise SSO, org/tenant provisioning, RBAC roles, user lifecycle management
data_classes.notes: Identity metadata (org IDs, tenant mappings, role assignments) is stored normalized in Postgres for enterprise operations. Never store raw credentials or tokens in Postgres — only reference keys to the credential store.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from audit_log.jsonl; Postgres enables efficient querying for compliance and incident investigation
data_classes.procurement_relevance: SOC 2 audit trail, access review, incident investigation, compliance reporting
data_classes.notes: Enterprise audit events capture who did what (admin actions, tenant provisioning, permission changes, consent changes). SHA256 hashes link to source artifacts. No raw content or secrets.

data_classes.replay_rule: artifacts are canonical; Postgres stores schema metadata for schema discovery and validation automation
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Schema governance, documentation index, automated validation pipeline metadata
data_classes.notes: Schema registry stores schema_id, version, file path, SHA256 hash of schema content. Enables automated schema discovery and validation report generation.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from validation output files; Postgres stores validation results for dashboard and trend analysis
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Continuous compliance evidence, schema drift detection, procurement validation gate
data_classes.notes: Validation results store schema_id, instance_sha256, passed/failed, error_messages[] (content-light: no raw instance content).

data_classes.replay_rule: runtime-only ephemeral; must not be persisted to Postgres
data_classes.procurement_relevance: N/A — debug packets are runtime-only and never shipped
data_classes.notes: Debug packets may contain raw prompts, completions, file content during debugging. Must never be stored in Postgres or exported. Local temporary files only, covered by debug-bundle-policy.

data_classes.replay_rule: JSON artifacts are canonical; Postgres stores benchmark metadata for capability comparison and routing decisions
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Model selection justification, local inference capability evidence, procurement evaluation data
data_classes.notes: Benchmark results store model_id, benchmark_kind, scores, latency stats. No raw prompts or completions.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from artifacts; Postgres is operational read replica. Partition may be empty when product telemetry is disabled.
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Product improvement analytics, agent-tool optimization, Ralph ranking refinement. Not required for audit or governance.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: When product telemetry consent is disabled, no telemetry_opt_in events are appended. Existing telemetry_opt_in partitions remain queryable but stale. No audit/evidence tables are affected.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from artifacts; Postgres is operational read replica. These events are required for governed operation.
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Operational monitoring, incident investigation, local diagnostics, SLO dashboards. Required for enterprise operational correctness.
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: NOT disabled by product telemetry opt-out. Only disabled by an explicit local_diagnostics setting (distinct from telemetry consent). Must remain available for governance, diagnostics, auditability, and cockpit correctness.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from audit_log.jsonl; Postgres enables efficient querying for compliance and incident investigation
data_classes.procurement_relevance: SOC 2 audit trail, compliance evidence, access review, incident investigation
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: Must function even when product telemetry is disabled. Enterprise audit/evidence tables are mandatory in enterprise mode. Disabling product telemetry must not weaken auditability, compliance evidence, incident investigation, or governance gates.

data_classes.replay_rule: runtime-only operational log; not exported. Rebuildable from source artifact state.
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Cockpit performance, projection cache correctness, WebSocket push integrity
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: LISTEN/NOTIFY-based projection invalidation is an operational substrate feature, not a telemetry feature. It must continue to function when product telemetry is disabled (assuming Postgres is enabled). Projection invalidation only degrades when enterprise_substrate_unavailable.

data_classes.replay_rule: can rebuild from artifacts; not required for operational correctness
data_classes.procurement_relevance: Product learning: adaptive tool suggestions, Ralph mission-candidate ranking refinement, orchestrator subagent optimization
data_classes.opt_out_behavior: When product telemetry is disabled, adaptive learning signals are not generated. Cockpit adaptive UI features visibly degrade. Existing adaptive signal partitions remain queryable but stale. No audit/evidence tables are affected.

taxonomy_exclusions.storage: Session memory only. Factor into SHA256 hashed telemetry metadata only.

taxonomy_exclusions.reason: Private content forbidden. Repository files contain proprietary code, configuration, potential secrets.
taxonomy_exclusions.storage: Never stored in Postgres. SHA256 hashes at most for change detection.

taxonomy_exclusions.reason: Secret-bearing. Provider API keys, OAuth tokens, GitHub tokens.
taxonomy_exclusions.storage: Keyring (macOS) or encrypted credential store only. Reference IDs only in Postgres.

taxonomy_exclusions.reason: Private content forbidden. Diffs contain proprietary code, file paths, potentially secrets.
taxonomy_exclusions.storage: SHA256 hashes and file count metadata only. Raw diffs in worktree-local files only.

taxonomy_exclusions.reason: Private content forbidden. May contain secrets, file paths, proprietary output.
taxonomy_exclusions.storage: Tool invocation receipts store SHA256 hashes and exit codes only. Raw output never in Postgres.

duckdb_lifecycle.current_role: Disposable analytical/read-side substrate over JSON/JSONL/CSV artifacts. In-memory DuckDB connection reads from artifact files via read_json_auto/read_csv_auto.
duckdb_lifecycle.post_migration_role: Remains as disposable analytical substrate for ad-hoc queries against local artifact files. Postgres replaces DuckDB for operational dashboards, cockpit widgets with materialized views, and cross-session correlation queries requiring indexed access.
duckdb_lifecycle.coexistence_principle: DuckDB reads raw JSONL files directly (zero-copy from filesystem). Postgres ingests structured envelope fields. Both produce content-light projections. Projection comparison tests validate equivalence.
